title: Greater Vancouver Zoo

services.name: Critter Cruisers
services.desc: Introducing our newest and best way to experience the Greater Vancouver Zoo - Critter Cruisers! These charming, animal-themed electric carts seat 4 people and offer guests a new and unique way to explore the Zoo. Please note that the driver must possess a valid class 5 license or equivalent to be eligible to rent, and all riders must be able to sit upright independently. The classic way to explore and get exercise at the Greater Vancouver Zoo! These shaded bikes feature 2 seats for kids and 2 to 4 seats for adults. Skip the line, buy online.
